note: Hand-authored fixture for RFC semantic-manifest-v0, revision 2 (rebased on Ash.Info.Manifest, ash v3.33.5, schema_version 1.0.0). Type terms use Ash's kind vocabulary and property names; the named enum type is hoisted into `types` and referenced by kind=type_ref, as Ash already does. Abridged: it covers 8 of the now-10 v0 symbol kinds. The `argument` kind is absent because AshEnterprise.Accounts.Team declares no action arguments (AshEnterprise.Accounts.User's read :sign_in_with_password is the natural second fixture for it), and `aggregate` is absent because Team declares none. Hash values are illustrative placeholders, not computed digests of the real source. Enum accepted-input modelling follows ash lib/ash/type/enum.ex:328-335 (atom, exact string form, or case-insensitive string).
